Simulate the longline fishery on top of the biomass truth

Source: R/fishery_simulate.R
simulate_fishery.Rd

Generates set-by-set pelagic longline operations (fleets, vessels with careers and turnover, trips, sets, location by preferential sampling and fidelity, latent fishing strategy, hooks and hooks between floats, catchability components, Tweedie catches of the target species and catches of companion species) with the COMPLETE truth of the fishing process. Observed data sets are derived afterwards with generate_scenarios().

Usage

simulate_fishery(biomass, cfg = om_fishery_config(), verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

biomass

An om_biomass object (simulate_biomass()), an om_truth object (fishery_truth()), a list with dom, pop and biomass, or the path to an .rds file with such a list (e.g. the Experimento 02 file biomass_true_base.rds).

cfg

Fishery configuration (om_fishery_config()).

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

An object of class om_fishery, a list with cfg, data (true fishery data, one row per set; observable columns first, then latent ones), fleets, vessels, vessel_years, trips, vessel_effects, truth, biomass_source, observed_columns, latent_columns.

Details

With om_fishery_config("BET_ICCAT") on the BET biomass truth, $data is identical, bit for bit, to TRUE_FISHERY_DATA_base.rds of Experimento 02. The caller's random number stream is left untouched.

See also

generate_scenarios(), check_fishery_truth(), make_fishery_figures(), om_write_fishery().

Examples

# \donttest{
sim <- simulate_biomass(verbose = FALSE)
fcfg <- om_fishery_config("BET_ICCAT",
    fleets = list(A = list(n_vessels = 5), B = list(n_vessels = 5),
                  C = list(n_vessels = 5), D = list(n_vessels = 5),
                  E = list(n_vessels = 5)))
fish <- simulate_fishery(sim, fcfg, verbose = FALSE)
fish
#> <pelagicOM fishery truth> label 'base'

#>   target catch: total 62,868 t | mean 0.425 t/set | zeros 51.2%
#>   sets by fleet x region:

#>       R01   R02   R03

#>   C  3627 25200     0
#>   D     0 25468  2313
